notes.title: Why did you postpone the release date?
notes.notes:
As you may have noticed, the Early Access release date has shifted from February to April. During the development of the game, we decided to make it more complex and enliven it with new features, which, of course, required to invest more time from us.

The interface got some new interesting elements.
And as for the stock exchange, aside from exchanging currency, you can now play on lowering / increasing the rate. Would you like to try yourself as a trader? Now you can predict the rate by reading the News provided by the events system
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31742353/c3d461d12fa1ef71d4e9b17b5bb84db71fb634e2.png[/img]

We’ve also added some new characters. They’ll help you with your farms’ repair and maintenance
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31742353/430bd23a2250478917abe189f8b434be1d5e5cd0.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31742353/0f7d139ae4ef44e8aeb35547fe05bb4c31f74a81.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31742353/5766f4e4f897393c8273ea688513988086951ed8.jpg[/img]

Thermal Control mode has become even more realistic
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31742353/688552718d1b32d9694bbd37cdf18708c705d94c.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31742353/8ffbacf4721a65e24eebd6ac13120c3cdaa5863f.png[/img]

And, of course, there are more interesting and colorful designs of chassis’ from our artist
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31742353/3b2e10999ba57cf2eaa8ef57369159093b2a7121.gif[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31742353/0656f531c79103d6dff06829f5587ee523d32d99.gif[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31742353/dcadd9798f9e9cc883a50adfcc34bd2bafb463d9.gif[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31742353/d2be8e6337f0f1c6e9712cdf5887e72bfa50f80d.gif[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31742353/265addf99689730a6cdbae4e8b7169df3059e565.gif[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31742353/436857d4032108a9500cb31cbf78dd3862b1a002.jpg[/img]

Now we are doing everything to balance the harsh reality of mining (a calculation of the hashrate, the problems of thermal and energy control, the impact of news on rates, the periodic shortage of components, the need for their upgrade and repair are included) and to add colorful, memorable elements to the game.
